executive_summary.description: Cloud-9 Assembly Project expands from cosmological complexity detection into two intersecting domains: Physics Track (light-matter equivalence breakthroughs) and Medical Track (pre-symptomatic disease detection via biological complexity breakdown).
executive_summary.unifying_principle: Complexity itself is the signal — whether detecting anomalous structure in dark matter halos or pre-symptomatic cellular disorganization.

new_validation_cases.title: Breit-Wheeler Pair Production
new_validation_cases.phenomenon: Direct observation of photon-photon collision producing electron-positron pairs in controlled laboratory conditions. First unambiguous demonstration of E=mc² as reversible, engineerable process.
significance_for_ac: Validates treating Assembly Index as phase-transition-sensitive: complexity spikes when energy configurations decohere into stable particulate structure
Provides laboratory-accessible analogue to Big Bang nucleosynthesis and radiation-matter equality epoch
Suggests A_c formalism must be extensible to pure field configurations (pre-matter complexity)

new_validation_cases.phenomenon: Polariton condensates and strongly coupled light-matter systems exhibiting solid-like ordered quantum states. Light particles interacting with matter form ordered, crystalline patterns under extreme coupling conditions.

Expands domain of 'assemblable' entities beyond baryonic matter

Reinforces that strong coupling can freeze dynamical systems into low-entropy configurations

medical_track.core_thesis: Disease is a breakdown in biological assembly rules. Just as cosmological A_c detects when dark matter halos deviate from expected random structure, A_c^bio detects when cellular and tissue networks deviate from healthy organizational complexity before functional symptoms emerge.

physics_parallels.physics_discovery: Light crystallizing into ordered structures under strong coupling
physics_parallels.biological_parallel: Healthy cells maintaining ordered structure through strong molecular coupling (membranes, cytoskeleton)

physics_parallels.physics_discovery: Breit-Wheeler: energy condensing into particle pairs
physics_parallels.biological_parallel: Mitochondrial energy metabolism driving cellular assembly and repair

medical_track.key_insight: If matter is 'condensed energy,' then disease may be understood as a failure of condensation — a breakdown in the energy-to-structure coupling that maintains healthy complexity.

formal_definition.equation: A_c^bio(tissue, t) = f(T(t), Φ(t), S(t), D(t), σ(t))

components.name: Topological Complexity
components.description: Persistent homology of cell-cell interaction graph. Captures multi-scale topological features (connected components, loops, voids) that characterize tissue architecture.
components.evidence: Persistent homology outperforms traditional morphological summaries in predicting disease-free survival in glioblastoma and distinguishes cancer subtypes in breast, prostate, and colorectal tissues.

components.name: Information Integration
components.description: Integrated information measure adapted from Tononi's IIT, quantifying how much a biological network integrates information beyond the sum of its parts.
components.evidence: Loss of integration precedes functional breakdown in neural and cellular networks.

components.name: Metabolic Entropy Production
components.description: Entropy production rate from metabolic networks.
components.evidence: Healthy tissues operate far from equilibrium with characteristic entropy signatures; disease disrupts these.

components.name: Developmental Trajectory Deviation
components.description: Deviation from a healthy reference atlas (e.g., Human Cell Atlas) across spatial scales.
components.evidence: Single-cell atlases provide baselines for healthy cellular organization.

components.name: Temporal Stability
components.evidence: Healthy complexity patterns are robust; pre-disease states show increasing fluctuation before collapse.

step_1.name: BASELINE
step_1.description: Map A_c^bio for healthy tissue across scales: single cell → neighborhood → tissue → organ

step_2.name: MONITOR
step_2.description: Track A_c^bio in patient samples over time

step_3.name: DETECT
step_3.description: Flag when A_c^bio deviates from healthy distribution BEFORE clinical markers cross threshold

step_4.name: LOCALIZE
step_4.description: Use topological persistence to identify which tissue regions are losing organizational complexity first

Colorectal cancer whole-slide images segmented using persistent homology profiles with better precision than CNNs
Single-cell RNA-seq enables high-resolution cellular atlases
Cell-free RNA tests show promise for early pancreatic cancer detection in high-risk patients
Spatial transcriptomics captures cell-cell interaction topology
Organizational breakdown (topology) precedes gene expression changes detectable by traditional methods
